allow_large: The owner set the AGENTS.md-only rule on 2026-10-01; two source files change and four existing tests that pinned the old CLAUDE.md behaviour must change with them
done_when: forge sync (and so init, adopt, migrate and upgrade) leaves no CLAUDE.md at the repo root: lines of CLAUDE.md that AGENTS.md doesn't already have are moved into AGENTS.md outside Forge's block, in their order, then CLAUDE.md is deleted; an @AGENTS.md import line and Forge's old block are dropped, never moved. Claude Code reads AGENTS.md itself when there is no CLAUDE.md. The skill and the guide say a repo keeps its rules in AGENTS.md only. Command-level tests: a CLAUDE.md with its own lines (moved, then deleted), one whose lines are already in AGENTS.md (deleted), and a second sync changes nothing.

findings.body: The earlier data-loss defect remains when AGENTS.md links to CLAUDE.md and that file already contains the current Forge block. New evidence beyond the previous review: `_agents` returns identical text in this case, so this filter excludes AGENTS.md from `changed`. The materialization at lines 343–344 never runs, but CLAUDE.md is deleted at line 348, leaving AGENTS.md dangling and losing the rules. The new command test starts without a Forge block, forcing a text change and missing this case. Include the required symlink materialization even when its contents already match, and cover that state through `forge sync`.
findings.title: Not done: forge sync leaves no CLAUDE.md while preserving the repo's rules in AGENTS.md

findings.body: A dangling CLAUDE.md symlink makes `Path.exists()` return false, so it is omitted from the deletion output and remains at the repo root after sync. This is new evidence beyond the ruling about CLAUDE.md links: that ruling covers links whose contents can still be read, whereas a dangling link bypasses deletion entirely. Check `is_symlink()` alongside `exists()` so sync removes the link itself.
findings.title: Delete dangling CLAUDE.md symlinks too

why: The owner wants no CLAUDE.md at all in repos Forge runs, only AGENTS.md, but forge sync keeps a CLAUDE.md that has lines of its own and adds an @AGENTS.md import to it
